description: Official gross monthly salaries by occupation group (ISCO-08) and age band (up to 29, 30–49, 50+), median and P10–P90, for all, women and men, by major region (BFS LSE). occupation = ISCO code or words (e.g. "nurse", "engineer", "teacher", "IT"); canton maps to its major region.

canton.description: Canton as 2-letter abbreviation, e.g. "ZH", "GE", "TI". Mapped to its BFS major region.

occupation.description: Occupation as ISCO-08 code or words, e.g. "25", "nurse", "software developer", "teacher".

region.description: BFS major region (NUTS-2): 1 Lake Geneva, 2 Espace Mittelland, 3 Northwestern Switzerland, 4 Zurich, 5 Eastern Switzerland, 6 Central Switzerland, 7 Ticino, -1 Switzerland. Use canton instead to map automatically.

year.description: Year of the earnings survey (every two years: 2012 to 2024), e.g. 2026; omit for the latest. An unavailable year returns the list of available years.

name: salary_by_occupation
title: Salaries by occupation
